Reason for Mistake: The Planner shifted the criterion from “are they orchids?” to “are they accepted orchid genera,” concluding that Laeliocattleya “does not” qualify. Laeliocattleya is an intergeneric orchid hybrid (a nothogenus) within Orchidaceae, so it is still an orchid. This misinterpretation of the task led to the incorrect answer.
